method.rust: u=log t: integrand becomes (1-g(e^u))² e^{-u/2}; panel uses exact ∫ e^{-u/2} du times (1-g_right)². s-grid is quadratic s=S (j/n)². I_f via v=u^α Beta-form Darboux.
